ORDER % 08.05.2025 CM Appl.27919/2025[Exemption from filing certified copy of the Impugned Judgment]
1. Allowed, subject to the Petitioner filing certified copy of the Impugned Judgment within a period of three weeks.
2. The Application stands disposed of.
CM Appl.27918/2025[Seeking condonation of delay in filing]

3. This is an Application filed on behalf of the Appellant seeking condonation of delay of 45 days in filing the present Appeal.
4. For the reasons as stated in the Application, the delay is condoned.
5.
The Application stands disposed of.

The present Appeal has been filed under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 impugning the judgment dated 17.12.2024 [hereinafter referred to as "Impugned Judgment"] passed by the learned Presiding Officer, MACT-01, South-West District, Dwarka Courts, New Delhi.
